description_en: Embeds a C2PA digital signature into a user-uploaded image and returns the download URL
description_zh: 对用户上传的图片嵌入C2PA数字签名并返回下载地址
name: SignUserImage

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be signed. HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported. Specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`. At least one of them must be provided
parameters.help_zh: 待签名图片的 URL 地址。支持 HTTP/HTTPS 链接。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

schema.description_en:
Success: Indicates whether the request is successful.
Code: The business error code. The value "OK" is returned if the request is successful.
Message: The additional information. The value "success" is returned if the request is successful.
HttpStatusCode: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned if the request is successful.
SignedImageUrl: The presigned download URL of the signed image. You can use this URL directly as the ImageUrl input parameter for other operations within the validity period.
CertificateSubject: The subject information of the signing certificate.
Algorithm: The algorithm used for signing, such as ps256 or es256.
SignTime: The signing time in ISO 8601 format, such as 2026-01-15T08:30:00Z
schema.description_zh:
Success: 请求是否成功。
Code: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"。
Message: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"。
HttpStatusCode: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200。
SignedImageUrl: 已签名图片的预签名下载地址，可在有效期内直接作为其他接口的 ImageUrl 入参。
CertificateSubject: 签名证书的主题（Subject）信息。
Algorithm: 签名使用的算法，如 ps256、es256 等。
SignTime: 签名时间（ISO 8601 格式），如 2026-01-15T08:30:00Z
